answer: A bond must be split across 2 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Because each atlas escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the ivory ledger records every share and the delta audit shows the split. Assembling that for 44 aliases means 44 times 2 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. That is 5 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
